main.applies_while: at every run (the pre-landing safeguard, F, landing) main is resolved by git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main and the record applies only if R1-R11 hold there: in particular AGENTS.md at that main equals paths[0].blobs.M and the first-parent commits on H..main that change AGENTS.md equal side_change_commits. The record names no later main commit, so the tool's own landing and the plan amendment do not change it; a different AGENTS.md blob means a new record with supersedes

ledger.note: the ledger as frozen at P; at F, the ledger pinned in F's table

paths.resolution: L:AGENTS.md = main's AGENTS.md with C's splices applied at main-translated offsets, each old_sha256 re-verified against main (DESIGN-v5.1 sec. 13.1; v2 sec. 13.2 'both changed')

unchanged_ledgered.rule: blob at main equals blob at H, and sha256 equals base_sha256, for every other ledger files entry

unchanged_corpus.rule: git diff --name-status H main lists no papers/ or book/ path and no generated corpus artifact (evaluated at run time; not a recorded list)

item_text.R1: main resolved by git ls-remote at F; H on main's first-parent chain; first-parent commits on H..main changing AGENTS.md equal side_change_commits
item_text.R2: AGENTS.md blob at main equals blobs.M
item_text.R3: overlapping occurrence count of D296 old bytes at H is 1, at start_H; sha256(H[start_H:end_H]) = old_sha256
item_text.R4: the same at main: count 1 at start_M; sha256(main[start_M:end_M]) = old_sha256
item_text.R5: common prefix of H and main >= end_H, so translation is identity (else the recorded delta equals the length change before start_H, and no main_changes range meets [start_M,end_M))
item_text.R6: Lx = main[:start_M]+new+main[end_M:]; Lx[start_M:start_M+len(new)] = new; sha256(new) = new_sha256; lines 36-39 of Lx equal those of H+D296 (T1')
item_text.R7: git blob id and sha256 of Lx equal expected.L
item_text.R8: git blob id and sha256 of H+D296 equal expected.X and the ledger's expected_sha256
item_text.R9: '## §A.49' occurs once in main and in Lx, at a >= end_M; Lx[a+delta:b+delta] = main[a:b] with the recorded sha256; and Lx[end_M+delta:] = main[end_M:]
item_text.R10: every other ledgered file unchanged H..main and equal to its base_sha256
item_text.R11: no corpus path changed H..main; every other changed path is covered by a referenced side-change class record (or another reviewed class record, such as the tool's landing paths or the plan amendment's paths)
